name: RC-B10-0066/2025 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the systematic repression of human rights in Iran, notably the cases of Pakhshan Azizi and Wrisha Moradi, and the taking of EU citizens as hostages
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making demands. It condemns Iran's human rights record, including a sharp rise in executions and the death sentences given to two Kurdish women activists, Pakhshan Azizi and Wrisha Moradi. It calls on Iran to release them and other political prisoners, to stop using detained EU citizens as bargaining chips, and to end the death penalty. It also asks the EU to support Iranian human rights defenders and civil society.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only states demands and opinions; Iran and EU governments must act.
- **Who it affects:** Iran's government, imprisoned activists and EU citizens held in Iran.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to EU institutions and Iranian authorities; no binding action follows.
